conclusion: H1 is not testable with current accepted independent event labels.

modality_feasibility.weather_only: Weather/rainfall scenario artifacts exist, but no independent accepted event target is available for scored evaluation.
modality_feasibility.terrain_only: Static terrain/hydrology feature artifacts exist, but one accepted flood episode cannot support held-out-event comparison.
modality_feasibility.sar_only: Excluded: SAR candidates are Tier D, and the 24 Nov scene may have been used in UNOSAT mapping.
modality_feasibility.combined: Feature sources can be inventoried, but no defensible same-target independent-event score can be computed.

metrics.reason: Not computed: no accepted independent held-out event labels.

split_decision: No fitting or scoring performed. Whole-event holdout cannot be formed from a single accepted flood-event year. Separating 12 Nov and 24 Nov would only test within-2015 episode/date transfer and would not establish H1.
next_evidence_needed: QA-accepted, date-matched 2021 and/or 2023 official map digitizations, with georeferencing QA and explicit event extent semantics.
Alternatively, accepted official December 2015 event extent if evaluating the December peak.
interpretation: This is a feasibility conclusion, not a negative model result. No modality has been shown to improve or fail to improve flood prediction.
